kpis.name: Overall SPI Compliance
kpis.description: Share of compliant checks across all applicable SPI evaluations in current filter scope.

kpis.name: Overall DPE Compliance
kpis.description: Share of compliant SPI checks for Defence Protected Environment (Protected security domain) assets in scope.
kpis.successMeasure: Target >= 95% compliant checks for DPE assets.

kpis.name: Overall DSE Compliance
kpis.description: Share of compliant SPI checks for Defence Secret Environment (Secret security domain) assets in scope.
kpis.successMeasure: Target >= 95% compliant checks for DSE assets.

kpis.name: Critical ICT System Compliance
kpis.description: Share of compliant SPI checks for assets assigned to ICT systems marked as Critical.
kpis.successMeasure: Target >= 95% compliant checks on Critical ICT Systems.

kpis.name: Critical Exposure in Production
kpis.description: Production assets with critical-vulnerability exposure requiring urgent treatment.

kpis.name: Discovery Coverage Compliance
kpis.description: Share of in-scope assets meeting discovery coverage across required tooling checkpoints.

kpis.name: ICT Systems have an active ATO
kpis.description: Share of in-scope ICT systems with an active Authority to Operate (ATO) record.
kpis.successMeasure: Target = 100% of ICT systems with active ATO.

kpis.name: ICT Systems are registered within DIIS
kpis.description: Share of in-scope ICT systems registered in the DIIS register.
kpis.successMeasure: Target = 100% of ICT systems registered within DIIS.

kpis.name: DIIS Systems Modelled Coverage
kpis.description: Share of ICT systems defined in DIIS that have been modelled in TSAAT.
kpis.successMeasure: Target = 100% of DIIS-defined ICT systems are modelled.

kpis.name: Networks Discovery Enablement
kpis.description: Share of defined managed networks with discovery status set to Discovery Enabled.
kpis.successMeasure: Target = 100% of defined networks are Discovery Enabled.
